fact: For the fourth quarter of 2025 the ministry gives national completeness of Monthly Activity Reports in DHIS2 as 96% and promptitude as 89% (DHIS2 Cameroun, consulted 23 February 2026), with the Est at 83% and the Nord-Ouest at 91% completeness, and no count or share of facilities entering their own reports.
